Package com.tangosol.coherence.rest.config

Class ExpressionAliasConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tangosol.coherence.rest.config.ExpressionAliasConfig
  • public class ExpressionAliasConfig
extends Object
    Configured Coherence REST expression aliases.

    Makes these aliases the operator-owned contract for hardened URL sort, projection, aggregator, and processor expression inputs.

    Since:
    26.04
    Author:
    Vaso Putica 2026.05.08
